# Second Line AI

> Second Line AI is a Baton Rouge, Louisiana-based HVAC revenue recovery partner for residential contractors. Its managed HVAC Revenue Recovery Desk™ helps HVAC companies capture more value from inbound demand during missed calls, overflow, after-hours, weekends, and slow follow-up.

- [Home](https://secondlineai.com/): Revenue Recovery Desk™ overview, Marie live demo, revenue-at-risk calculator, fit qualification, and FAQ.
- [How It Works](https://secondlineai.com/how-it-works.html): The Revenue Recovery Framework™ explained.
- [About](https://secondlineai.com/about.html): Second Line AI's Louisiana focus and operating philosophy.
- [FAQ](https://secondlineai.com/faq.html): Frequently asked questions.

## Positioning notes

Second Line AI is not positioned as a generic AI receptionist or a replacement for an HVAC office team. Marie is an intake specialist inside the broader managed HVAC Revenue Recovery Desk™. Marie does not diagnose HVAC equipment, invent pricing, or make unauthorized technical promises. Revenue estimates on the site are illustrative only and are not guarantees.
